title: Prime Minister shares glimpses of his address during inauguration of Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026 in Mumbai
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared glimpses of his address during inauguration of Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026 in Mumbai.
In a series of X posts, Shri Modi said;
“Addressed the Global FinTech Fest 2026 in Mumbai.
Spoke about India’s remarkable FinTech journey and the success of UPI.
Called for:
Expanding UPI’s global footprint.
Taking FinTech beyond payments to credit, insurance, savings, investments and pensions.
Harnessing Agentic AI, Tokenisation and Quantum.
Top-notch cyber security and ethical data protection.
Stronger FinTech consumer protection index and greater innovation.”
